root_cause: The unsafe shift duplicates ownership with ptr::copy and commits Vec length after consuming an iterator whose panic or inaccurate ExactSizeIterator::len can expose uninitialized or duplicated elements.
hidden_obligations: For a valid exact-size row iterator and index, insert all yielded values in order at that row, preserve other rows in order, and increment the row count once.

Malformed short iterators and iterator panics must not expose uninitialized values or cause duplicate destruction. Panic-path leaks are permitted, not required. No rollback layout or exact number of panic-path drops is prescribed.
Normal completion and collection destruction must drop owned values exactly once; incoming values are moved, not cloned.
allowed_changes: implementation under src/ preserving the public API
temporary Vec length and metadata commit order
leak_policy: Leaks allowed only in panic suites, never required. No exact panic-path leak count is an oracle.
non_goals: not a general proof of toodee soundness
not a claim about column-only operations
